captions.text:
Northline Supply: a fictional merchant with a real return workflow.
Follow one partial return from customer request to refund recovery.

Maya returns one tee from a three-unit order.
The server calculates the partial refund: $35.00.

The request reserves only the selected unit.
Support can review the policy snapshot and the customer's reason.

Ava approves the eligible partial return with a reason.
The recorded decision identifies who acted and why.

Jules records receipt and passes inspection.
Finance can now review the reserved refund amount.

Sam reviews and confirms the exact $35.00 amount.
A durable operation keeps its original payment key across attempts.

The payment simulator stored success, but its response was lost.
The app keeps the outcome unknown and the amount reserved.

The API, worker, and payment simulator have actually restarted.
Their databases and the original refund operation are preserved.

Recovery confirmed the original refund. Independent ledger: one $35.00 entry.
Three signed late-event copies left one success audit and no duplicate refund.

Two tees remain available. Every decision and refund keeps its history.
Local simulation only. No real payments; personas are demo authentication.
